original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚军队在科吉州击毙两名绑架嫌疑人并缴获5000发弹药
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚陆军第12合成旅在科吉州伊加拉梅拉/奥多卢地方政府区的埃迪莫格博森林开展后续行动，击毙两名疑似绑架者并缴获武器弹药。军方称行动于2026年11月3日进行，此前11月2日已对该森林一处疑似绑架者藏身处实施突袭。军方公共关系代理助理主任哈桑·阿卜杜拉希中尉通过声明披露上述情况。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Troops of the 12 Composite Brigade of the Nigerian Army have killed two suspected kidnappers

key_facts.fact: 行动中缴获武器和弹药
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: recovered arms and ammunition during a follow-up operation in Edimogbo Forest

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the operation, conducted on November 3, 2026, followed an earlier raid on a suspected kidnappers’ hideout in the forest on November 2
